details:
Disclaimer: This is not meant to be a suggestion to replace the current sticker sharing methods.

Currently we only get the option to copy stickers into our gallery. Now while I do not know how this is implemented in the background, if this creates a new file for every copy, then that is not optimal for anyone involved. 

As an option to sharing your stickers for download, I would like to see that you can give others permissions on your stickers. They then get a reference to your sticker with the permission to use it. This might require pages in the menu "Shared with me" and "Shared by me" in order to manage permissions and select which stickers you want on your Wheel. 

This would allow users to share with less impact on storage, but obviously would require rights management to be implemented for the galleries. 

In addition, I think it would be awesome to have group stickers (and emojis), that can be shared by group owners / gallery managers with their communities.
title: Sharing Sticker Permissions and Group Stickers
